newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's agricultural imports rise Jan to Sept.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's agricultural imports rise Jan to Sept.

text.p: South Korea's agricultural product imports from January to September rose 20.0 percent in value terms to $5.03 billion from $4.19 billion a year earlier, the agriculture ministry said on Tuesday.
Livestock product imports gained 1.2 percent to $947.2 million from $936.0 million a year ago.
The rise was mainly due to higher prices on the international market, the ministry statement said.

In volume terms, corn imports for the first nine month fell 1.5 percent to 6.54 million tonnes from 6.64 million tonnes a year ago and soybean imports fell 2.2 percent to 1.01 million tonnes from 1.03 million tonnes, while wheat imports surged 21.5 percent to 2.18 million tonnes from 1.79 million tonnes.
Beef imports fell 4.5 percent to 128,000 tonnes from 134,000 tonnes a year earlier and pork imports fell 10.1 percent to 40,000 tonnes from 45,000 tonnes.
